Home.name: Jüri Petrotsenko
Home.whoami: Bachelor's graduate in IT Systems Development
Home.about_me: Junior Full-Stack Developer with a Bachelor's degree in IT Systems Development and 6 months of commercial web development experience. Experienced in building full-stack applications using .NET, Next.js and TypeScript. Strong practical experience with microservice architecture, RESTful APIs, authentication, databases, message brokers and containerized applications..
Home.philosophy: As a developer, I look beyond just writing code; I focus on understanding the ecosystem of an application. I have a natural analytical mindset that allows me to dissect complex systems, track down anomalies, and uncover the true root causes of errors. For me, software development is not about completing tasks—it is about leveraging my technical expertise to solve real-world problems and deliver meaningful impact.
Home.passion: Interested in continued development as a developer by engaging in real projects, learning best practices, and increasing technical skills in a work environment.
Home.reach_out: If you are looking for a developer who doesn't just write code but delivers meaningful solutions, I’d love to connect. Reach out, and let’s discuss how we can bring your projects to life.
